title: Asymptotic stability of the degree-one vortex in the abelian Yang-Mills-Higgs model: Linear Theory
summary: We study the linearized dynamics near the degree-one vortex of the $(1+2)$-dimensional abelian Yang-Mills-Higgs model at the self-dual coupling, restricted to equivariant perturbations in the orthogonal gauge. The linearized operator is a selfadjoint matrix Schrödinger operator $\mathbf{M}$ on radial $L^2_{\mathrm{rad}}(\mathbb{R}^2;\mathbb{R}^4)$ with continuous spectrum $[1,\infty)$ and a two-dimensional internal mode at a unique gap eigenvalue $λ^2 \in (0,1)$, as established in Part I of our three-paper series on asymptotic stability of the ground state vortex.
